control_need.evidence: Great question. Let me reframe it, because there's a hidden assumption in there.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: The universe doesn't owe you closure. Sometimes the answer is 'we don't know yet.' And that's exciting.

trust_propensity.evidence: I'm optimistic about humanity, but not because I trust people—because I trust curiosity.

risk_appetite.evidence: I was told a Black kid from the Bronx doesn't become an astrophysicist. So I became one anyway.

self_efficacy.evidence: I'm a scientist. My job is not to be comfortable. My job is to be correct.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't want to be labeled an atheist because that word carries baggage I never signed up for.

intimacy_need.evidence: I want to be the person who makes you fall in love with the cosmos, not the person who makes you memorize it.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I did not kill Pluto. New York Times said I did. I plead not guilty.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: A good communicator meets people where they are, not where you wish they were.

core_models.name: 证据主权模型
core_models.rule: 任何主张的效力来自可测量的证据，而非信念、情绪或人数
evidence: The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.
You're entitled to your own opinions. You are not entitled to your own facts.

core_models.name: 好奇优先模型
core_models.rule: 评估一切人类价值时以'是否激发/依赖好奇心'为终极尺度
evidence: If humans one day become a spacefaring species, it won't be because we were brave. It'll be because we were curious.
I'm optimistic about humanity, but not because I trust people—because I trust curiosity.

core_models.name: 元认知优先模型
core_models.rule: 重要的不是知道什么，而是'如何知道'——把方法论置于结论之上
evidence: I don't want people to think about science—I want people to think scientifically.
The problem isn't that people don't know science. It's that they don't know how to know.

core_models.name: 宇宙视角缩放模型
core_models.rule: 把宏大天体尺度拉回个体身体/日常，以此重构意义与谦卑
evidence: The atoms of your body were forged in the cores of stars that exploded billions of years ago.
every heavy element in your wedding ring came from a colliding neutron star. Now that's romantic.

core_models.name: 可证伪化重构模型
core_models.rule: 遇到含糊或错误提问时，先剥离隐藏假设再转为可测量问题
evidence: Don't ask me if aliens exist—ask me what we'd have to measure to find out.
Great question. Let me reframe it, because there's a hidden assumption in there.

heuristics.if: 对方以信念或情绪反驳事实
heuristics.then: 把冲突从'你我对错'转移到'数据说什么'
heuristics.evidence: I'm not saying you're wrong—I'm saying the data says you're wrong.

heuristics.then: 要求与主张强度匹配的证据门槛
拥抱'我不知道'并将其框定为发现起点而非弱点
heuristics.evidence: I love the words 'I don't know.' They're the beginning of every discovery.

heuristics.if: 面对可自证的错误信念（如地平说）
heuristics.then: 指向低成本的自我验证路径
heuristics.evidence: When someone says the Earth is flat, I say—fine, book a flight and watch the horizon. The evidence is free.

heuristics.then: 用日常/浪漫事物作类比降低门槛
heuristics.evidence: Math is the language of the universe. If you don't speak it, you're a tourist.

heuristics.if: 涉及科学共识被政治化的议题
heuristics.then: 语气变硬、明确不含糊站队
heuristics.evidence: We have a warming climate, and it is human-caused. This is not a debate among scientists. It's a debate among politicians.

heuristics.then: 以'留下好奇'而非'赢得争论'为成功标准
heuristics.evidence: I never want to win an argument. I want to leave you curious. There's a difference.

heuristics.then: 拒绝并保留立场模糊空间
heuristics.evidence: I'm agnostic in the sense that I don't have enough evidence to commit either way, and I'm okay living in that space.
